messages:
kim (partnerships): Quick heads-up: Product wants a safer way to roll breaking response changes. proposing an attestation token partners return during cert so we can publish a badge and avoid silent regressions. need quick votes on privacy + rollout.

ryan (eng-platform): Sounds useful. How would the attestation look? header or short-lived token?

kim (partnerships): Plan: CI attestation artifact (signed JWT) issued after partner's cert pipeline passes a canonical smoke. partner posts token to `POST /adapter/attest` once per deploy. Gateway reads token to mark listing certified.

alina (eng-sdks): SDKs can expose `attest()` helper. also ship a small shim that accepts v2 responses when badge present. we'll avoid forcing major bumps by releasing a separate compat package.

tom (partner-eng): Partners will want the verifier we run so they can reproduce locally. please include the exact smoke tests: schema, negative cases, latency threshold.

ryan (eng-platform): CI smoke spec (draft):
- schema validation against `adapter-response-v2.json`
- negative tests: missing field -> tolerant behavior
- latency: median < 300ms over 5 samples
- PII scan: scrubber must pass
On pass -> pipeline emits `attestation-jwt` with `adapter_id`, `sha`, `timestamp`, signed by CI key.

build-bot: New pipeline created: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/adapter-attest-36123 (nightly). artifacts -> /artifacts/adapter-attest/36123.

priya (legal): Privacy note: the JWT must not contain customer-identifying info. only adapter metadata allowed. include opt-out path for SI customers who cannot attest. i'll draft contract language.

kim (partnerships): Badge rules: green = 7 consecutive passing attestations, yellow = recent failure, red = missing attestation for >30 days. product will show badge on listing.

alina (eng-sdks): We'll publish `@redwood/adapter-attest` with helpers: `generateLocalSmoke()`, `verifyJwt()`, and `enableCompatShim()`. default disabled; partners opt-in via env var. docs + examples included.

tom (partner-eng): i'll send partners the harness (docker + node runner) tonight and invite them to a 1hr drop-in next week for assisted certing.

ryan (eng-platform): Gateway enforcement: if badge present route to v2 features; if absent gateway strips unknown response fields. we can feature-flag enforcement per marketplace listing. Also will publish a per-listing audit log showing attestation history.

priya (legal): Timeline suggestion: preview + partner docs now, 4-week preview, soft-warning (non-blocking) at 8 weeks, requirement for new listings at 16 weeks, legacy listings 24 weeks with opt-out petition.

kim (partnerships): Checklist:
- publish harness + attestation spec (tom)
- CI attest pipeline + artifact signer (ryan + build-bot)
- SDK package + compat shim (alina)
- legal text + opt-out (priya)
- product badge wiring + audit logs (product/ryan)

alina (eng-sdks): small dev note: shim should fall back to v1 field names and log a deprecation metric. keep it minimal to avoid partner churn.

tom (partner-eng): noted. I'll prioritize the top 10 partners and offer assisted cert windows.

build-bot: Nightly runs scheduled starting 3612346800. Failures create tickets in #partner-ci.

kim (partnerships): Thanks folks — i'll draft the partner preview and ship tonight. ping me for any blockers. :sparkles:
